name: market_profile_poc_v1
mechanism: On NIFTY, the developing session Market Profile concentrates the majority of traded volume within a Value Area (VA) that shifts incrementally as institutional TWAP/VWAP algorithms and market makers repeatedly transact near the session's fairest price — the Point of Control (POC). When NIFTY briefly probes outside the VA boundary (a 10-25 spot point excursion) but fails to sustain a close outside the VA for more than 30 seconds, it signals that the initiative selling/buying was absorbed rather than welcomed. VWAP-benchmarked algorithms that filled orders at the VA boundary now delta-hedge or rebalance toward POC, creating a directional pull of 10-20 NIFTY spot points within 30-90 seconds.
core_signal_oneliner: Price probes outside the 15-minute+ Market Profile Value Area then re-enters, triggering a reversion toward the Point of Control
